name: Mega-City One
note: Fan work in the spirit of Judge Dredd's Mega-City One, which belongs to Rebellion. Nothing is surveyed and no assets from the comics, films or games are used - tools/make-megacity.py generates megacity-osm.json from a seed and every shape is modelled from scratch here. Positions are [lat, lon] against the arbitrary projection origin below; the map is 6.4 km across.
attribution: Mega-City One is fan work: geometry generated by tools/make-megacity.py. Judge Dredd © Rebellion. No assets used.

el._: the Zoom Line runs high above the sector streets

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: Grand Hall of Justice
landmarks.info: Sector 1 · the seat of the Justice Department. Everything that happens in eight hundred million lives is decided somewhere inside it, and the shield front is the part they let you photograph.

landmarks.name: Statue of Judgement
landmarks.info: A hundred and sixty metres of bronze on the plaza, one arm out over the crowd. At this size it stopped being a figure and became architecture.

landmarks.name: The City Wall
landmarks.info: One hundred and twenty metres of concrete along the whole western edge. Past it there is the Cursed Earth, and nothing is built out there.

landmarks.name: The Cursed Earth
landmarks.info: Broken ground the city turned its back on. Whatever is out there is not the Justice Department's problem until it comes to the wall.

landmarks.name: The Black Atlantic
landmarks.info: East of the city. It is not a colour anybody chose.

landmarks.name: Port of Mega-City One
landmarks.info: Sheds, cranes and holding yards along the water.

landmarks.name: Justice Central Zoom Station
landmarks.info: Where the Zoom Line comes into Sector 1, forty-four metres above the street.

landmarks.name: Sector 7 Green
landmarks.info: A park, on the grounds that somebody once wrote one into the sector plan.
